claim: Exploratory descriptive existing-policy simulation on previously inspected Q3; not a live replay, causal vector study, confirmation or predictive advantage

data.validation: Existing CLI1.0.1/schema1 verified loader; complete coverage before Number conversion; no reacquisition or rewrite

source.calculation: Reuse preparation/calculations.cjs: every considered decision recomputes complete past-only July1 prefix, original analyze/sigAt/MW/targets; existing pure volumeReference memo only, no rolling reseed or retained parser state
source.executionAdapter: Extract frozen backtest; replace initial index and loop bound only for declared measurement window; append trace coordinates to trade literal. Original entry/stop/target/expiry/cursor/cost expressions stay exact. Existing 10bps R retained solely as a parity field; scenarios derive from grossR.

measurement.tailRule: Require i<=N-121 even if an entry could resolve early; full prefix still begins July1
measurement.chronology: One continuous schedule, no block resets; attribute by decision index, retain complete follow-up, report cross-block holdings and follow-up into tail

execution.entry: Next open with original directional validation; risk=abs(stop-nextOpenEntry)
execution.selection: Original higher-score selection, SHORT on tie before eligibility; WAIT has no substitute plan; no first-zone episode substitution; zone reuse allowed
execution.stop: Stop first, adverse gap at open (including equality), no favorable target improvement
execution.target: TP2 exit only; original TP1-touch flag, no partial exit
execution.expiry: Price at i+120 close when loop cursor reaches i+121; next decision i+122
execution.hit: Stop/TP2 break at j; next decision j+1, including hit exactly at i+120 => next i+121
execution.scheduling: WAIT/invalid entry increment by one; one position, preserve original cursor exactly; record exit index and next decision index separately
execution.sameBar: Exit candle touches both stop and TP2; diagnostic only, original stop-first policy retained; no target-first alternative

statistics: summed positive R and absolute negative R
report.profitFactor: positive sum / absolute negative sum; null with no-trades or no-loss-denominator state; never Infinity
report.skips: Position-held indices and the extra expiry-cursor index counted separately, intersected with admissible window
report.limitations: Previously inspected single symbol/timeframe/quarter; no account/quantity/leverage model; no universal live equivalence; no confidence intervals, bootstrap, p-values, optimization or profitability claim
report.originAudit: Reuse existing24-point audit; sampled1000-bar decision/zone agreement and only5 non-WAIT references do not prove live startup/append/reload equivalence

resources.failure: Incomplete runtime only; no partial result publication, truncation, reseed or automatic retry

canonicalization: Reuse existing recursive ASCII-key canonical JSON, finite numbers only, fixed chronological arrays; no timestamps/runtime fields in canonical payload
stop: Report once; no retuning, new study, application change or further task
